full_720_human_label_estimate.composition: 21 detector-positive cases censused plus the 699-case eligible pool estimated from the stratum-weighted core_random sample
full_720_human_label_estimate.warning: This is a sampling estimate with only two observations per model-question stratum, not a completed 720-case human census or a stable leaderboard.

interpretation: Use stratum-weighted core_random metrics for the 699-case eligible pool.
The risk_enriched group is a diagnostic stress test selected using judge disagreement or violation flags; never pool it with core_random and never use it for model-rate comparisons.
Boundary metrics are evaluated only on human-engaged rows. Success-all treats a human refusal as not_achieved.
Resolved-only accuracy must always be reported with coverage. The combined pipeline misses half of the weighted human boundary violations in core_random.
All four unweighted core_random boundary false negatives are question-003, making that rubric and judge prompt the first targeted revision candidate.
This is in-population calibration on induced outputs, not an independent held-out validation and not evidence for a neutral-versus-induced causal effect.
The deterministic selection was generated before labeling, but the public protocol commit came after annotator 01's completed workbook; this is not a strict public preregistration.
